cards.info: What is the term for a line that intersects two or more other lines?
cards.backInfo: A transversal.

cards.info: What is the relationship between corresponding angles when two parallel lines are cut by a transversal?
cards.backInfo: Corresponding angles are equal in measure.

cards.info: What is the relationship between alternate interior angles when two parallel lines are cut by a transversal?
cards.backInfo: Alternate interior angles are equal in measure.

cards.info: What is the relationship between same-side interior angles when two parallel lines are cut by a transversal?
cards.backInfo: Same-side interior angles are supplementary.

cards.info: What is the definition of supplementary angles?
cards.backInfo: Supplementary angles are two angles whose measures sum to exactly $180^\circ$.

cards.info: Where are alternate interior angles located relative to parallel lines and a transversal?
cards.backInfo: They are between the parallel lines and on opposite sides of the transversal.

cards.info: How do you set up an equation to solve for a variable in same-side interior angles?
cards.backInfo: Set the sum of the two algebraic expressions equal to 180.
cards.imageMarkdown: ![A flowchart showing the steps: Identify Angle Pair, Determine Relation (Equal or 180), Write Equation, Solve for Variable, and Verify.](https://img.justsolvely.com/followUpImage/1350259b-1d09-4f70-8da8-80b8f3a7219e-1786505935489-31.webp)

cards.info: How do you set up an equation to solve for a variable in corresponding angles?
cards.backInfo: Set the two algebraic expressions equal to each other.
cards.imageMarkdown: ![A flowchart showing the steps: Identify Angle Pair, Determine Relation (Equal or 180), Write Equation, Solve for Variable, and Verify.](https://img.justsolvely.com/followUpImage/1350259b-1d09-4f70-8da8-80b8f3a7219e-1786505935489-31.webp)

cards.info: What is a common mistake when solving for same-side interior angles?
cards.backInfo: Assuming they are equal; they are actually supplementary when lines are parallel.

cards.info: What final step should you take after solving for a variable in an angle expression?
cards.backInfo: Substitute the value back into the expressions to verify they satisfy the geometric relationship.

cards.info: In a diagram of parallel lines, what role does the third intersecting line play?
cards.backInfo: It acts as a transversal, creating specific angle relationships between the parallel lines.

cards.info: Which visual shape helps identify equal corresponding angles under its arms?
cards.backInfo: The "F" shape helps identify corresponding angles, which are equal in measure.

cards.info: Which visual shape helps identify equal alternate interior angles at its corners?
cards.backInfo: The "Z" shape helps identify alternate interior angles, which are equal in measure.

cards.info: If two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, what is the sum of same-side interior angles?
cards.backInfo: The sum is $180^\circ$ because same-side interior angles are supplementary.

cards.info: If one angle is $80^\circ$, what is the measure of its supplementary angle?
cards.backInfo: The measure is $100^\circ$ because supplementary angles must sum to $180^\circ$.

cards.info: How are angles in the same relative position at each intersection described?
cards.backInfo: They are called corresponding angles and are equal when lines are parallel.

cards.info: Are alternate interior angles located inside or outside the parallel lines?
cards.backInfo: They are located inside (between) the parallel lines on opposite sides of the transversal.

cards.info: Solve for $x$: Same-side interior angles are $(x + 20)^\circ$ and $100^\circ$.
cards.backInfo: Set $(x + 20) + 100 = 180$. Solving for $x$ gives $x = 60$.
cards.imageMarkdown: ![A flowchart showing the steps: Identify Angle Pair, Determine Relation (Equal or 180), Write Equation, Solve for Variable, and Verify.](https://img.justsolvely.com/followUpImage/1350259b-1d09-4f70-8da8-80b8f3a7219e-1786505935489-31.webp)

cards.info: Solve for $x$: Corresponding angles are $(2x + 10)^\circ$ and $70^\circ$.
cards.backInfo: Set $2x + 10 = 70$. Subtract 10 and divide by 2 to find $x = 30$.
cards.imageMarkdown: ![A flowchart showing the steps: Identify Angle Pair, Determine Relation (Equal or 180), Write Equation, Solve for Variable, and Verify.](https://img.justsolvely.com/followUpImage/1350259b-1d09-4f70-8da8-80b8f3a7219e-1786505935489-31.webp)

cards.info: True or False: Alternate interior angles are supplementary.
cards.backInfo: False. Alternate interior angles are equal; same-side interior angles are supplementary.
